notes: SFPTToken takes no constructor arguments and mints its entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals once to msg.sender. On transfer and transferFrom, transfers from PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cb358380d2e3de08a90 to any other address send floor(amount / 50) minor units (2%, rounded down) to the constant treasury 0x900bcc8d58b67ff741c32d0cd9a28aa1555c8068 and the remaining amount to the recipient. All transfers to PoolManager, including sells, seed deposits and PoolManager self-transfers, are untaxed. Wallet-to-wallet transfers are untaxed. The tax rate and addresses are constants; there are no owner, admin, post-deployment mint, burn or upgrade entry points. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei, totalSupply and the deployed currency order.
